Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for Central Sanskrit University Recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Part-Time Teacher posts at Central Sanskrit University is scheduled for 11 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Part-Time Teacher post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Part-Time Teacher position at Central Sanskrit University, with one vacancy each for Vyakarana, Sahitya, and Political Science.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for Central Sanskrit University Recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary structure for the Part-Time Teacher position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Part-Time Teacher post is a fixed consolidated remuneration of Rs. 1,000/- per period/lecture, with a maximum limit of Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligibility criteria for the Part-Time Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The eligibility criteria for the Part-Time Teacher posts are as per UGC norms for Part-Time Teachers. Specific details for each subject are available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Central Sanskrit University in Puri, Odisha. The exact venue details will be provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any age limit for the Part-Time Teacher posts?
faq.answer: The official notification should be referred to for specific age limit details. Age relaxation rules, if any, will also be mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. How should I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to report at the designated venue on the interview date with all required documents. No online application is required.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Part-Time Teacher posts at Central Sanskrit University will be based on a Walk-in Interview.
